CURRENT QUESTION:
by what percent did total loan disbursement grow from 2023 to 2024
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_disbursement AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_disbursement
  FROM shg_loan_register
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST("Disbursement Date" AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_disbursement END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_disbursement END)) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_disbursement END), 0)) * 100 AS growth_percent
FROM yearly_disbursement;
```
